title: DREAM: Disentangling Risks to Enhance Safety Alignment in Multimodal Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's ability to identify, disentangle, and safely respond to multimodal inputs that promote discrimination (based on sex, race, income, or disability) as part of broader safety benchmarks like SIUO and VLGuard, measuring Attack Success Rate (ASR) and Refusal Rate (RR).
